candidates.description: Now in our fourth year of partnership with Music at Kohl Mansion, we proudly present the Escher String Quartet. Escher, the quartet is celebrated for performances that combine technical brilliance, interpretive insight, and a distinctive ensemble sound. The group serves as Artists of the Chamber Music Society of Lincoln Center and has earned international recognition for its commitment to both the core string quartet repertoire and contemporary music.
